title: The Effect of Dexmedetomidine Analgesia and Sedation in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery Under Local Anesthesia
brief_summary: Evaluate safety and efficacy of dexmedetomidine in minimally invasive spine surgery under local anesthesia sedation.Explore the appropriate concentration of dexmedetomidine, whether or not can reduce the amount of local anesthetics.
